name: share.link
description: The share link for an idea or a shoot, made the first time someone shares it, with an unguessable token; and the comments on it.
sql:
with l as (
  insert into brandbase.share_links (token, brand_id, kind, target_id) values (brandbase.new_token(), :brand, :kind, :id)
  on conflict (kind, target_id) do update set token = share_links.token returning *
)
select jsonb_build_object('link', brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(l)) || jsonb_build_object('createdAt', brandbase.iso(l.created_at)), 'comments', brandbase.thread(:kind, :id)) as result from l
